name: ch25_driving_instructor_asks
alt: A calm driving instructor in a small hatchback asks her learner a question about the turn ahead, and the learner signals and turns on her own.
scene: A wide side view of a small white hatchback driving on a quiet tree-lined Indian road on a Sunday morning, cut away so we can see both people inside. In the driver's seat, a young woman learner (early 20s, yellow kurta, hair in a plait) holds the steering wheel with both hands, eyes on the road, looking thoughtful but confident, her left hand just flicking the indicator stalk. In the passenger seat, a driving instructor in her forties (teal salwar suit, short hair, spectacles) sits relaxed with her hands resting in her lap, turning slightly towards the learner and asking a question; a white speech bubble from her holds a big question mark next to a small road sign for a left turn. Her right foot hovers near a second brake pedal on her side, drawn small and visible through the cutaway. Ahead of the car on the RIGHT, the road forks at a junction with a lane arrow painted on the tarmac, and a blinking amber indicator light on the car shows the learner chose the turn herself. A dashed arrow traces the car's intended path into the left lane. In the far background, a distant lorry is just visible, small, near the horizon. Labels: "ASK" above the instructor's speech bubble, and "OWN DECISION" above the junction on the right. Calm morning light, gentle mood of a lesson going well.

name: ch25_society_secretary_scooter
alt: A society secretary who shouted at a scooter owner in front of the neighbours later sees all the same neighbours vote down his proposal at the society meeting.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided down the middle by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: early morning at the gate of an Indian apartment block, a scooter parked across the gate. The society secretary (50s, white kurta, grey moustache, spectacles) stands at an open flat door shouting, one arm pointing at the scooter, angry red face; the scooter owner (30s, sleepy, in a vest and lungi) stands in the doorway looking embarrassed. Above them, three neighbours lean over their balconies watching with folded arms and frowns. A small wall clock on the gate pillar reads 8:00. Label "SHOUTED" at the top of the left panel. RIGHT panel: the society meeting a week later in the building's common hall, rows of plastic chairs. The same secretary stands at a small table holding up a paper with a simple sketch of a watchman's cap on it, looking surprised and deflated. Facing him, the same three neighbours from the balconies, now seated, each raises a hand holding a red card with a cross on it; the scooter owner sits quietly at the back. A dashed arrow curves from the balconies in the left panel to the raised red cards in the right panel, showing the onlookers paying him back. Label "VOTED DOWN" at the top of the right panel. Morning light on the left, flat tube light on the right, uneasy mood.

key: joint family is planning a cousin
name: ch25_family_wedding_plan
alt: At Sunday lunch an uncle asks the family how to plan a wedding, and an aunt, a cousin and a nephew each offer a piece of the plan.
scene: A warm, wide view of a joint family sitting around a long dining table at Sunday lunch, steel plates with rice, dal and a bowl of papad in the middle. At the head of the table on the LEFT, the eldest uncle (60s, cream kurta, white hair, spectacles) leans forward with open palms, asking a question; his white speech bubble shows a small stack of rupee notes, a little calendar page with a big "2" on it and a question mark. Around the table, three relatives answer, each with a small bubble showing their idea: an aunt (50s, plum sari) holds up her phone with a tiny cook's hat icon for a caterer she knows; a young cousin (20s, coral top) points to a small sketch of a wedding hall with a price tag cut in half; a teenage nephew (teal T-shirt) holds a laptop showing a simple ticked list for RSVPs. Their three bubbles connect with thin dashed lines to a single paper plan lying in the middle of the table, which has a green tick on it. Everyone is smiling and engaged, leaning in. Labels: "ASK" above the uncle's bubble, and "OUR PLAN" just above the paper plan in the centre. Soft midday light through a window, cheerful family mood.

name: ch25_sandesh_big_order
alt: A sweet-shop owner sits with his sweet makers over tea and asks if they can take a huge order; one offers moulds, one an early shift, one packing, and they all say yes.
scene: Inside the back room of a busy Kolkata sweet shop during the festival season, trays of white sandesh stacked on shelves on the LEFT and a big kadai on a stove at the back. In the centre, the owner (50s, white dhoti-kurta, round spectacles) sits on a low stool with a clay cup of tea, leaning forward with an open hand, asking a question; his speech bubble shows a big order slip reading "5000" with a question mark. Around him on stools sit three karigars with clay tea cups: a senior sweet maker (50s, white vest, grey hair) holding up two flower-shaped sandesh moulds with a small bubble showing two moulds; a middle-aged worker (teal shirt) pointing to a small alarm clock reading 4:00; and the youngest (late teens, amber T-shirt) holding a stack of flat sweet boxes and a ribbon. Small dashed arrows from each of their ideas lead to the order slip, which now carries a green tick. All three are smiling and nodding, the youngest giving a thumbs-up. In the window on the RIGHT, a hint of festival lights and a decorated pandal outline. Labels: "CAN WE?" above the owner's speech bubble, and "YES!" above the three karigars. Warm lamp light, busy but happy mood.

key: teenage cousin to help unload groceries
name: ch25_cousin_grocery_bags
alt: The same teenage cousin carries grocery bags sulkily when ordered, and cheerfully carries two bags when asked for help with the heavy rice bag.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided down the middle by a thin vertical line, the same scene in both halves: an auto-rickshaw stopped outside a small house gate, grocery bags and a large sack of rice on its back seat. LEFT panel: an older cousin (30s, coral kurta) stands with hands on hips, pointing sternly at the bags; a teenage cousin (15, grey hoodie, earphones) drags one small bag towards the door with a sulky face, phone still in his other hand, while the front door in the background swings with a small zigzag "bang" mark showing it slammed. A small snail drawn by his feet shows how slowly he moves. Label "ORDER" at the top of the left panel. RIGHT panel: the same older cousin holds one hand on her lower back with a tired face and a speech bubble containing a rice sack and a question mark; the same teenager, phone tucked into his pocket, cheerfully lifts the heavy rice sack on his shoulder and carries a second bag in his other hand, smiling; through the open door a mother is seen at the stove with a pot. A green tick floats beside the teenager. Label "ASK" at the top of the right panel. Late afternoon light, ordinary weekday mood.
